title: Tune-A-Video: One-Shot Tuning of Image Diffusion Models for Text-to-Video Generation
grouping: A narrow left column and a wide right grid. The left column stacks an orange rounded 'Tune-A-Video' box with a flame icon, a plus sign, and a dashed rounded grey container holding three blue bow-tie shapes labelled 'Pretrained T2I' (plain, personalised for a style, with pose control), each with small example images. The right grid has five rows of six frames: the source clip on top with small down-arrows under each frame, then four generated clips, each introduced by a centred prompt line between the rows.
shapes_depth: Photographic frames of equal size with thin white gutters; no boxes around rows. Prompts are written in a handwritten italic face in quotes, with the words that changed from the source prompt coloured blue. One row adds a strip of black pose-skeleton thumbnails after its prompt, joined by a plus sign. The model components on the left are flat filled shapes with white bold text.
proposed_highlight: The method itself is the single orange box at the top of the left column, set apart from the blue pretrained models in the dashed container below it by a plus sign. In the grid, the edits are carried by blue words in each prompt line.
lesson: In a video-editing teaser, put the source clip as the top row of frames with small down-arrows to the edited rows below, and introduce each edited row with its prompt written between the rows with only the changed words coloured.
notes: Venue ICCV from Semantic Scholar title match; year = arXiv preprint year (2212.11565). Mostly photographic content. Annotation note (2026-11-15): teaser of results; the method appears only as a small left column, not a method diagram

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: a grid of video frames: the source clip ('A man is dribbling a basketball') as the top row of six frames, and four edited versions as rows beneath it, each frame column aligned in time and each row captioned by its prompt with the changed words in blue

relations.form: five rows of six frames each, the same pose in each column across rows, edited rows differing only in subject and style (James Bond on a beach, cartoon astronaut, Disney prince, Iron Man)
frames run left to right in time; short down arrows under each source frame point to the first edited row

on the left an orange 'Tune-A-Video' box with a flame icon is joined by a large plus to a grey dashed column of pretrained text-to-image models; in the last row a pose-skeleton strip is added to the prompt by another plus sign

the left column's model variants sit roughly beside the rows they produce - a plain Pretrained T2I with 'James Bond' and 'An astronaut' sample images, one 'personalized for Modern Disney Style', one 'with pose control' beside the Iron Man row

channels.colour: blue text = the words changed in each prompt; orange = the Tune-A-Video component (flame = trained); blue fill = pretrained T2I models, so blue carries both 'edited words' and 'pretrained model'
channels.shape: hourglass (bow-tie) shapes = pretrained T2I models; rounded box = Tune-A-Video; photos and frames = data; quoted handwriting-style text = prompts
channels.line: short black down arrows only between the source row and the first edit; plus signs mark combination
channels.frame: grey dashed rounded column = the family of pluggable pretrained T2I models

quality.strengths: the edited videos are drawn as identical rows under the source with frame columns aligned, so 'motion preserved, subject and style changed' is read by scanning down a column; the changed words of each prompt are tinted, so the edit is legible without comparing sentences
quality.weaknesses: the method itself is not shown - Tune-A-Video is one box and its relation to the T2I models is a plus sign; the left-column variants are only loosely aligned with the rows they produce; the down arrows exist only between the source and the first edited row; blue codes both prompt edits and model fills

insights.structure: A narrow left column (orange Tune-A-Video box with flame icon, plus sign, dashed container of three blue bow-tie 'Pretrained T2I' models) beside a wide grid of five rows of six frames.
insights.data: Video is shown as rows of real frames with white gutters; prompts are handwritten italic lines between rows with edited words in blue; one row adds black pose-skeleton thumbnails.
insights.emphasis: The method is the single orange box; edited prompt words in blue point at what changed between source and output rows.
insights.flow: Top to bottom: the source clip on top with down arrows under each frame, then each prompt line introduces the generated row below it.

arrangement.units: left model column (dashed rounded container) and right unframed frame grid; rows separated only by prompt lines
arrangement.inputs_as: source video frames with its quoted prompt
